text: No, 13.2 hectares of the 2021 loss was outside the pine plantation. The 81.3-hectare loss area included 68.1 hectares within the pine plantation (*Pinus elliottii y Pinus taeda*) and 13.2 hectares outside mapped forest. The event met corroboration rules, with 98% of the area confirmed as forest in 2020. The plantation loss aligns with the MGAP 2021 forest map, while the remaining 13.2 hectares occurred in unmapped areas.
